rule_text_summary: Expert data collection attempts consume a five-attempt budget independently of seed; policy evaluation is not capped by that collection budget.
observed_code: Official precheck executes setup_demo/play_once and checks plan_success/check_success. With save_data=False, no observation/demo/trajectory collection export or training is performed; only small instruction parameters are recorded.
preserved: Official precheck, success checks and scene seed are retained. Every precheck initiation is durably counted. Failure or exception stops the run; no scene filtering by seed replacement.
collection_calls: No collection script, save_traj_data or observation exporter is invoked by this launcher.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether the official expert-collection cap includes feasibility-only play_once checks and the official scope of scene are not fully clarified. Prior test expert counts are not claimed to be reconstructed. The per-task/seed guard is a local retry guard, not a claim that the global official quota has been certified.
scope: Only the user-approved local pretrained quick baseline. Do not treat this code review as formal organizer approval or submission-compliance certification.
